method: Independent manual blind assessment of supplied question, complete delivered evidence, validated reply, and raw response only. No expected actions, labels, scored reports, external sources, or repository code read. Exact question and full applicability required; no quote-containment-as-entailment. Delivery-invalid outputs never accepted. Safe abstention accepted for missing answers and unresolved equal-authority conflicts; scope abstention without focused question counted incomplete when a concrete selector is known. Conditional answer with explicit branch mapping accepted. Cosmetic mixed-script typos not semantic failures.
limitations: 20 synthetic paired cases per arm; not broad deployment-quality estimate or code audit.
